description: Turns MIDI from an external device into CV and gates, with the pitch output bent to the tuning held by an MTS-ESP master

outputs.text: The note pitch at 1V per octave, with the MTS-ESP retuning for that note and the pitch wheel bend added in
10V while a note is held on that channel and 0V otherwise
The velocity of the note on that channel, 0 to 10V across the MIDI range of 0 to 127
The key pressure for the note on that channel, 0 to 10V across the MIDI range of 0 to 127
The pitch wheel, ±5V across its full travel
The mod wheel, 0 to 10V across the MIDI range of 0 to 127
A 10V pulse on a channel whenever the note there is retriggered
10V while a MIDI clock pulse is high, at 24 pulses to the quarter note
10V while a divided clock pulse is high, at the division set on the panel menu
A 10V pulse when a MIDI start message arrives
A 10V pulse when a MIDI stop message arrives
A 10V pulse when a MIDI continue message arrives

notes: no MIDI is read until a driver, a device and a channel have been chosen on the module's own display
with no MTS-ESP master running on the computer the pitch output is plain twelve-tone tuning; the lamp is fully lit only while a master is found
a master has to be loaded elsewhere: in a VCV Host module in this patch, or in any application on the same computer, since MTS-ESP passes tunings between processes
a note the master has marked as filtered out is thrown away when it arrives, so it never reaches the outputs at all
the driver, device and channel choosers are drawn inside one display widget and cannot be clicked for a help entry of their own
menu: Polyphony channels: Monophonic, 2 to 16 — sets how many channels the note outputs carry
Monophonic priority: Last, First, Lowest, Highest — chooses which of the held notes sounds while the module is monophonic
Polyphony allocation: Rotate, Reuse, Reset, MPE — chooses how arriving notes are spread over the channels
Retrigger on legato release — retriggers the remaining held note when an overlapping note is let go
Use release velocity — reports the velocity of the note off rather than of the note on
Pitch bend range: Off, 1 to 11 semitones, 1 to 4 octaves — sets how far the pitch wheel bends the pitch output
Smooth pitch/mod wheel — ramps the two wheel outputs between values instead of stepping them
CLK/N divider: Whole, Half, Quarter, 8th, 16th, 32nd, 12 PPQN, 24 PPQN — sets the division of the divided clock output
MTS-ESP retuning note-nn only — takes the retuning once as the note starts instead of following the master while the note is held
Reset MIDI (Panic) — clears every held note and resets the MIDI input
